name: connector-conventions
description: Conventions for working through connectors: the rules a store carries in its own content, and the rules for using it. A skill per connector — Google Drive, where a CONVENTIONS document governs its folder and everything beneath it; GitHub, whose MCP read path silently mangles issue and pull request text, whose write path corrupts a long URL, and whose Actions tools carry the timings a wait can be sized from — plus cross-cutting skills, currently data-boundaries, for information that crosses between sources. Always on, so a connector's behaviour is known before its result is trusted.
